# AGENTS.md — GitHub Actions

Run jobs on Windows runners (`windows-*` labels) under native `pwsh`. Native Windows build and process checks contribute to the pull-request `all checks passed` verdict; Wine runs Windows Node on hosted Linux only in `ci-master.yml`. Python runtime CI checks Linux/Windows x64 on pull requests and Linux ARM64 plus both macOS architectures on master pushes; releases retain all five targets ([platform policy](workflows/ci-master.yml)). `ci.yml` is pull-request-only. Master-only platform checks and manual runner benchmarks live in `ci-master.yml`, which listens to master pushes and `workflow_dispatch`, not `pull_request`; separating workflow triggers keeps master-only jobs out of PR check panels.

Pull-request Linux lanes (`node 24 / static`, coverage, snapshots and artifacts), the verdict job, filename checks, and the sandbox `bwrap` leg use `ubuntu-latest`. The sandbox matrix also uses `ubuntu-24.04`, `ubuntu-24.04-arm`, and `macos-latest`. Native Windows lanes and manual Windows packaging use `windows-latest`. Manual macOS packaging uses `macos-latest`. Python builder targets keep native GitHub-hosted labels: `ubuntu-latest`, `ubuntu-24.04-arm`, `macos-latest`, `macos-15-intel`, and `windows-2025`. Both packaging workflows upload installer artifacts.
